name: Côtes de Gascogne
terms: Indication Géographique Protégée, the tier below AOC. It replaced vin de pays in 2009.

notes: Côtes de Gascogne wines show aromatic freshness, mostly fruity or floral.
Their intensity varies with the grape and how the wine is made.
Wines with some sweetness, and the late-harvest whites, have riper, more developed fruit aromas.

blurb.text: A Gascony district making mainly white wine, mostly in the Gers department, in the same area as Armagnac.
